worldconfig-diffusionTerrain-hover: Generate terrain and climate with the Terrain Diffusion neural model instead of the vanilla landform generator.
worldconfig-diffusionScale-hover: How many real-world metres one block represents, horizontally and vertically alike. Smaller numbers spread every valley and mountainside over more blocks, so the landscape feels bigger to walk through, but need a taller world to hold the mountains at true scale.
worldconfig-diffusionScale-30: 30 m per block (most terrain per step)
worldconfig-diffusionVerticalExaggeratio: Multiplies terrain height above sea level. At 1x a block is exactly as tall as it is wide, so the landscape is at true scale in every direction; anything above that trades realism for relief in a world too short to hold real mountains.
worldconfig-diffusionClimate-hover: Whether the model drives the climate as well as the terrain. The model predicts real bioclimatic variables — annual temperature and how far it swings through the year, annual rainfall and how unevenly it falls — which set the world's temperature, rainfall, forests and seasons in place of Vintage Story's latitude bands.
vsterraindiffusion:command-elevation: Show the model elevation and climate at your position
